WBS_issue.printed_assertion: The full PΓL(2,2^e) action on W(2^e) is never locally point-primitive.
WBS_issue.exact_construction: A=PΓL(2,8), G=Aderived=PSL(2,8); D=N_G(Sylow3), choose Sylow2 U with |D∩U|=2; P=N_A(D), B=P∩N_A(U), L=<U,B>. Local right-coset actions P/B and L/B.
WBS_issue.limitation: This checks the literal local subgroup model; a uniform written identification with all WBS flags and repaired all-q exclusion remains pending. It does not refute the final RWPRI exclusion: the q8 pencil is imprimitive.
WBS_issue.proposed_remaining_proof: Use the regular normal cyclic torus of order q+1 on the pencil. Primitivity forces q+1 prime, hence e a power of2. Then the line quotient F2^e/<1> has dimension e-1>1 and cyclic2-power zero stabilizer, so cannot be irreducible. Verify this actual semilinear line embedding and all subgroup cases before acceptance.
